punchline: Ten shekels for being late made Haifa parents late more often, and removing the fine did not undo it.
thirty_sec: Two economists put a ten-shekel fine on parents who picked up their kids more than ten minutes late at six Haifa daycares. Lateness almost doubled. When the fine was dropped after twelve weeks, it stayed that high. The authors suggest the fine turned lateness from a small wrong into something you could simply pay for, and that the old guilt did not come back with the old rule.
